mutations.before: where org_id = $1 and campaign_id = $2 and revision = $5
mutations.after: where org_id = $1 and campaign_id = $2 and ($5::text is not null)
mutations.because: replacing the revision equality check with a null check on $5 keeps the parameter referenced (no bind-count error) but makes the compare-and-swap match any row for the campaign regardless of its stored revision, so a stale-revision write would silently succeed instead of conflicting.
command: a stale expected revision is refused
